next_exact_obligation: Choose an explicit positive entry/descendant scale profile and prove Xi-specific relative adaptive-jet bounds on old cells together with a corrected Riemann-Siegel half-plane or weighted slope-gap theorem on each new right strip.
proof_boundary: Positive-scale contact/degree invariance, the full scaled heat derivative, additive and relative transport, Hermite specialization, cofinal factor, and scale-switch homotopy are exact. The Xi entry cone, relative descendant bound, interface estimates, and all-j composition are not proved. This does not prove Q209, Lambda<=0, RH, PF-infinity, or the Clay prize.

rows.claim: For any continuous positive scale s(t,x), the scaled first jet has exactly the same contact set as the ordinary first jet.
Positive scaling preserves boundary degree and local contact index through an explicit GL+(2,R) homotopy.
The time derivative of a time-dependent scaled jet has one explicit scale-variation term.
The original convex-cell additive transport theorem remains valid with the full time-dependent derivative.
rows.formula: If V_s(t_j,I) subset C, d=dist(0,C)>0, and M>=sup_collar||partial_t V_s||, then ||V_s(t,x)||>=d-|t-t_j|*M

rows.claim: An integrable relative heat-jet bound transports every nonzero old jet multiplicatively and cannot create a positive-time contact.
A whole old phase cell inherits a positive descendant clearance without requiring an additive ratio below one.
The multiplicity-compatible scale s=sqrt(2t) inserts the exact Hermite condition number into the generalized successor.
On t_j=1/(5j), the relative descendant factor is positive at every stage and its one-step logarithmic cost tends to zero.
Any two positive jet scales can be blended without changing contacts or degree, allowing separate entry and descendant coordinates.
A finite base, a new-strip entry cone, and a relative scaled-jet bound on every descendant collar would give the cofinal successor without an endpoint-simplicity assumption.
rows.formula: entry strips: q_j.V_(s_entry)>=eta_j>0; descendant collars: ||partial_t V_(s_desc)||<=kappa_j(t)||V_(s_desc)|| with finite collar integrals; compose through a positive scale homotopy

status: exact time-dependent scaled-jet successor and relative transport lemma with one open two-regime Xi antecedent
